scope: Disposable MariaDB, actual admin include with synthetic sessions; never production

cases.name: owner installs only five new tables and never automatically enables campaign
manager can view but cannot mutate campaigns
invalid or absent csrf token cannot create activity
unprivileged role cannot read operator screen
owner creates enabled campaign and preserves prior commitments
owner pauses only new participation and preserves money counters
owner enables only unused draft with a current start
stale revision and cross-tenant campaign id cannot be changed
historical daily commitments cannot be lowered and false budget reads cannot save
PDO exception details do not leak into administrative HTML
broken ledger receipt is marked for reconciliation without forged payout
explicit false begin or commit prevents admin configuration mutation
